Name: Marnie new look (Seasonal.Festival)
Author: pinzol
Description:
[size=4][b][color=#ffff00][b][color=#ffff00][size=5]UPDATED FOR 1.6 + SEASONAL OUTFITS + FESTIVAL OUTFITS[/size][/color][/b]
[/color][/b][/size]
-------------------------------------------------

Marnie is lovely and seriously deserves better in the game. So I decided to at least give her a complete makeover, Brushed her hair, gave her a new haircut, new clothes. 
[list]
[*]Added seasonal outfits
[*]Added aerobics day outfit (She will wear it all day on tuesday for Aerobics class at Pierre's if it's not raining)
[*]Marnie appears in her aerobics outfit during Harvey's 6-heart event
[*]Added two festival outfits:﻿ Flower Dance and Spirit's Eve 
[*]Added variations of Leah's paintings (from Leah's 14-heart event)
[/list] 
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/17876/17876-1715264638-1050271002.gif[/img]

-------------------------------------------------

[color=#ffff00][b]How to install:
[/b][/color][list]
[*]Have Content patcher installed
[*]Download archive and drop the folder inside it into your Mods folder
[*]Highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0 to change mod's settings more comfortably. Or just change [b]config.json[/b] file in the mod's folder manually.
[*][b]HIGHLY[/b] recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14212]Fourteen Heart Events for All[/url] by AirynS to get Marnie's paintigs from Leah's heart events without the need to marry her.
[/list]
-------------------------------------------------

[b][color=#ffff00]Configuration options:[/color]
[/b][list]
[*][color=#f4f4f4][b]Use festival outfits[/b] (True/False) - toggle Festival outfits on and off[/color]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Leah's paintings edit [/b](from Leah's 14-hearts event. The one Marnie hangs on the wall in her room after the event):
[/list] ﻿﻿-[b] Normal [/b]- Just an edit of default variants of these paintings to fit this mod's sprites better
﻿- [b]??? [/b]- A fun option. Why? I dunno, I was in that mood. I think it turned out just great.

[list]
[*][b]'My first painting' edit[/b] (from Leah's 14-hearts event. The one your farmer recieves after said event):
[/list] ﻿﻿- [b]Vanilla[/b] - Just a slight edit of vanilla painting to match the colours of my mod better,
﻿- [b]Norma[/b]l - Not as potato like as vanilla one, but still pretty weird. Bold of me to call it normal actually.
﻿- [b]???[/b] - Same fun option as from the previous config. Try it out. It's beautiful.
